How big is Koh Samui? | Koh Samui covers 228.7 km², making it Thailand's second-largest island after Phuket. A full loop of the 51 km ring road takes about 90 minutes without stops, and the highest point, Khao Pom, is 635 m.
How many people live on Koh Samui? | About 70,000 people are registered as residents (70,059 in 2019), but the real population is considerably higher because many workers and long-stay foreigners live on the island without being registered there.
How long is the Koh Samui ring road? | About 51 km. The main ring road is Route 4169, with connectors Route 4170 in the south-west and Route 4171 in the north-east. A non-stop loop takes about 90 minutes.
How far is Koh Samui from Bangkok? | About 470 km in a straight line. By air it is 1 h 05–1 h 10 from Suvarnabhumi; overland by train or bus plus ferry it takes 12–17 hours.
Which airlines fly to Koh Samui? | Bangkok Airways operates all domestic routes into Samui Airport (USM): Bangkok Suvarnabhumi, Don Mueang, Phuket, Krabi, Chiang Mai and U-Tapao. Internationally, Bangkok Airways and Scoot fly from Singapore, and Bangkok Airways from Hong Kong, with seasonal Chengdu flights.
What is the rainiest month on Koh Samui? | November, with about 445 mm of rain over 16 rain days on 1991–2020 averages. October (about 295 mm) and December (about 263 mm) are also wet; February is the driest month at about 64 mm.
What is the emergency number on Koh Samui? | Call 1669 for an ambulance, 191 for the police, 199 for fire and 1155 for the English-speaking Tourist Police. Bangkok Hospital Samui's hotline is 1719.
How long can I stay in Thailand without a visa? | Since 15 September 2026, citizens of 60 countries and territories, including the UK, US, Australia and all EU states, get 30 days visa-free. You can extend once by up to 30 days at the Koh Samui Immigration Office for 1,900 THB.
How much does a taxi from Samui Airport cost? | Airport taxis charge fixed fares of roughly 400–700 THB per car depending on the zone, with Chaweng usually about 400–600 THB. A shared minibus costs about 100–250 THB per person, and Grab about 300–600 THB to the main resort areas.
~When is Ang Thong Marine Park closed? | Every year from 1 November to 15 December; it reopens on 16 December. The rest of the year it is open daily from 08:00 to 17:00, and the park fee is 300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child, paid in cash.
